description: An agent-based model simulating user review and rating behaviors on Amazon, Goodreads, and Yelp. It focuses on user interactions with items, leveraging LLMs for review generation and rating prediction.

behaviors.name: write_review
behaviors.description: Simulates a user writing a review based on their preferences and past behaviors.
behaviors.algorithm: Use LLM to generate review text based on user preferences and item attributes.

behaviors.name: rate_product
behaviors.description: Simulates a user rating a product after interaction, influenced by user preferences and item attributes.
behaviors.algorithm: Predict star rating using LLM, considering historical ratings and user-item interactions.

behaviors.name: receive_review
behaviors.description: Updates product's review count and average rating based on incoming reviews.
behaviors.algorithm: Adjust average rating and review count upon receiving a review.

interactions.name: review_and_rate
interactions.description: A user writes a review and rates a product based on their experience.
interactions.effect: User generates a review and rating, influencing product's average rating.

algorithms.LLM-based_review_generation: Language model for generating review text based on user and item data.
algorithms.LLM-based_rating_prediction: Language model for predicting star ratings based on user preferences and item attributes.

data_sources.name: amazon_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Train and validate Amazon user review behaviors.

data_sources.name: goodreads_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Train and validate Goodreads user review behaviors.

data_sources.name: yelp_train_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Train and validate Yelp user review behaviors.

data_sources.name: review_sample.json
data_sources.purpose: Provide historical review data for calibration.

files.name: main_simulation.py
files.description: Main file to run the simulation.

files.name: agent_definitions.py
files.description: Defines user and product agents and their behaviors.

files.name: environment_setup.py
files.description: Sets up the simulation environment and network.

files.name: evaluation_metrics.py
files.description: Calculates evaluation metrics for simulation results.
